Listing highlights
In San Marcos, North County San Diego
San Marcos sits among lakes and parks in North County San Diego, with LEGOLAND a short drive away.
Full kitchen, laundry, and free parking
A full kitchen with a coffee maker and cooking basics, plus a washer, dryer, and free parking.
Outdoor seating and a workspace
The house has outdoor seating, air conditioning, Wi-Fi, and a workspace for getting things done.
Welcome to Casa Del Cactus, your charming hideaway! Nestled among beautiful trees and cacti, this freshly renovated home offers comfort, privacy, and relaxation. Enjoy peaceful mornings sipping coffee on the patio, sunny afternoons barbecuing on the deck, and beautiful sunsets beneath open skies. This cozy, privately gated two-bedroom getaway is perfect for families and friends looking to unwind, reconnect, and create lasting memories. Your peaceful escape awaits!
